{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace VeriSlop

/-- Faithful input domain: JSON objects containing ordered request collections.
    This domain is outside the executable contract profile. -/
opaque Input : Type
/-- Faithful output domain: JSON objects with Boolean and scaled-balance collections. -/
opaque Output : Type

/-- The required pure solver declaration. Its Python implementation semantics
    are outside the supported Lean executable profile. -/
opaque solve : Input → Output

/-- Inputs conform to the specified fields, types, and value constraints. -/
opaque A1 : Input → Prop

/-- Output fields and request ordering satisfy the frozen structure requirement. -/
opaque outputStructureAndOrdering : Input → Output → Prop
/-- Acceptance results correspond exactly to sufficient available balances. -/
opaque acceptanceCorrect : Input → Output → Prop
/-- Scaled remaining balances and denominator satisfy the frozen requirement. -/
opaque scaledBalancesCorrect : Input → Output → Prop
/-- Failed requests retain the balance after refill and record that scaled balance. -/
opaque failedRequestRetainsRefilled : Input → Output → Prop
/-- The returned value and contents are JSON-serializable. -/
opaque jsonSerializable : Output → Prop
/-- Both supplied public examples produce their stated outputs. -/
opaque publicExamplesMatch : Prop
/-- The scaled integer token-period simulation follows the frozen refill and
    deduction rules exactly. -/
opaque exactScaledInvariant : Input → Output → Prop
/-- The Python implementation uses only the standard library and performs no
    file, network, printing, or other external I/O. -/
opaque pythonStandardLibraryAndNoIO : Prop

theorem O1 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) : outputStructureAndOrdering x (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O2 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) : acceptanceCorrect x (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O4 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) : scaledBalancesCorrect x (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O5 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) : failedRequestRetainsRefilled x (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O7 (x : Input) : jsonSerializable (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O8 : publicExamplesMatch := by sorry
theorem O3 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) : exactScaledInvariant x (solve x) := by sorry
theorem O6 : pythonStandardLibraryAndNoIO := by sorry

theorem A1_nonvacuous : ∃ x : Input, A1 x := by sorry

end VeriSlop","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"verislop.prompts-0.2.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["VeriSlop.solve"]},{"obligation":"A1","predicate":"VeriSlop.A1"},{"obligation":"O1","theorem":"VeriSlop.O1"},{"obligation":"O2","theorem":"VeriSlop.O2"},{"obligation":"O4","theorem":"VeriSlop.O4"},{"obligation":"O5","theorem":"VeriSlop.O5"},{"obligation":"O7","theorem":"VeriSlop.O7"},{"obligation":"O8","theorem":"VeriSlop.O8"},{"obligation":"O3","theorem":"VeriSlop.O3"},{"obligation":"O6","theorem":"VeriSlop.O6"}],"internal_obligations":[{"id":"A1_nonvacuity","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"VeriSlop.A1_nonvacuous","witnesses_for":["A1"],"description":"Requires a witness input satisfying the frozen input structure and value constraints; the collection-valued JSON input domain is unsupported by the executable profile."}]}}
